verdict.rationale: The ESD employer portal (eServices/EAMS) holds user data such as quarterly tax and wage reports, so in-product AI insights are a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence mentions AI-generated insights, suggestions or analytics. The documented features are filing, appeals, penalty waivers and account setup, and the authenticated portal could not be inspected.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
